comparison.objective: Load a caulking gun and seal a bath joint, versus adjust and validate a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually release and retract a plunger, insert a cartridge, actuate a trigger, and trace a continuous bead.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridge loaded and joint coverage meets bead/gap thresholds with the gun put down; no impact-response criteria.
comparison.reason: Tool loading and material deposition test different force control and outcomes.
